query:
select
display_id as "Patient ID",
first_name as "First name",
last_name as "Last name",
to_char(date_of_birth, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date of birth",
date_part('year', age(current_date, date_of_birth))::integer as "Age",
sex as "Sex",
village as "Village",
viewed_by_user as "Viewed by user",
user_email as "User email",
user_role as "User role",
viewed_at_facility as "Viewed at facility",
to_char(((date_time_viewed at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as "Date and time viewed"
from "reporting"."ds__patients_access_logs"
where
((date_time_viewed at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) >= 
:fromDate
and
((date_time_viewed at time zone 'Australia/Sydney') at time zone coalesce(nullif(:timezone, ''), 'Australia/Sydney')) <= 
:toDate
and
case
when 
:patientId is null then true
else patient_id = 
:patientId
end
and
case
when 
:userId is null then true
else viewed_by_user_id = 
:userId
end
order by date_time_viewed
name: Audit - patient views
notes:
This report lists all of the users that have viewed the selected patient's record for the selected date range and parameters. A patient 'view' is defined as a single access to a patient record where a patient record can be accessed from a patient listing table such as the 'All patients' table, the 'Active lab requests' table, or the 'Immunisation register'. A patient record can also be accessed via features such as the 'Recently viewed patients' and the scheduling module. 
Views are listed in chronological order. If multiple views are made to a patient's record within a logged session, these views will be grouped together and displayed as a single view in the report.
